sn46.54:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Koliyesu viharati Haliddavasaṇaṃ nāma Koliyānaṃ nigamo || || 2.
sn46.54:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Haliddavasanam piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu || || 3.
sn46.54:1.3: Atha kho tesam bhikkhūnam etad ahosi ||
sn46.54:1.4: Atippago kho tāva Haliddavasane piṇḍāya carituṃ ||
sn46.54:1.5: yaṃ nuna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmā ti || || 4.
sn46.54:2.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhim sammodiṃsu ||
sn46.54:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārānīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etad avocuṃ || || 5.
sn46.54:3.1: Samaṇo āvuso Gotamo sāvakānam evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn46.54:3.2: Etha tumhe bhikkhave pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyam tathā catutthaṃ || iti uddham adho tīriyaṃ sabbādhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharatha || ||
sn46.54:3.3: Karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || tathā dutiyam tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ || iti uddhaṃ adho tiriyam sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam karuṇāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharatha || ||
sn46.54:3.4: Muditāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catuttham || iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam muditāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhenā pharitvā viharatha || ||
sn46.54:3.5: Upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || tathā dutiyam tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catuttham iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharathā ti || || 6.
sn46.54:4.1: Mayam pi kho āvuso sāvakānam evaṃ dhammaṃ desema || ||
sn46.54:4.2: Etha tumhe āvuso pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || la [pe] ||
sn46.54:4.5: Upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ ||
sn46.54:4.6: iti uddham adho tiriyam sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantam lokam upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharathā ti || || 7.
sn46.54:4.7: Idha no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyo so kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa Gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidam dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanam anusāsaniyā anusāsaninti || ||
sn46.54:5.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃsu na paṭikkosiṃsu ||
sn46.54:5.3: Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa attham ājānissāmāti || || 8.
sn46.54:5.4: Atha kho te bhikkhū Haliddavasane piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || || 9.
sn46.54:6.1: Idha mayam bhante pubbaṇhasamayam nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Haliddavasanam piṇḍāya pavisimha ||
sn46.54:6.2: tesaṃ no bhante amhākam etad ahosi ||
sn46.54:6.3: Atippago kho tāva Haliddavasane piṇḍāya carituṃ ||
sn46.54:7.1: yan nuna mayam yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmāti || || Atha kho mayam bhante yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkamimha || pe [pa] || tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodimha ||
sn46.54:7.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdimha || Ekam antaṃ nisinne kho amhe bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etad avocuṃ || ||
sn46.54:8.1: Samaṇo āvuso Gotamo sāvakānam evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ||
sn46.54:8.2: Etha tumhe bhikkhave pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || la [pe] ||
sn46.54:8.5: cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ || iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharathā ti || ||
sn46.54:9.1: Mayam pi kho āvuso sāvakānam evaṃ dhammaṃ desema ||
sn46.54:9.2: Etha tumhe āvuso pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha || la ||
sn46.54:9.5: cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharatha || tathā dutiyam tathā tatiyam tathā catutthaṃ || iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharathā ti || ||
sn46.54:9.6: Idha no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyo so kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā Gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yad idaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanam anusāsaniyā vā anusāsaninti || ||
sn46.54:10.1: Atha kho mayam bhante tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam bhāsitam neva abhinandimha na paṭikkosimha || anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamimha
sn46.54:10.2: Bhagavato santika etassa bhāsitassa attham ājānissāmāti || || 10.
sn46.54:11.1: Evaṃ vādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā || ||
sn46.54:11.2: Kathambhāvitā panāvuso mettācetovimutti kiṅgātikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kim pariyosānā || ||
sn46.54:11.3: Katham bhāvitā panāvuso karuṇācetovimutti kiṅgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā || ||
sn46.54:11.5: Katham bhāvitā panāvuso upekhācetovimutti- -kim pariyosānā ti || ||
sn46.54:11.6: Evam puṭṭhā bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti uttariñca vighātam āpajjissanti || || 11.
sn46.54:11.9: Nāhaṃ tam bhikkhave passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sasamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesam pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittam ārādheyya aññatra Tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā || || 12.
sn46.54:12.1: Kathambhāvitā ca bhikkhave mettācetovimutti kiṅgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā || ||
sn46.54:12.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu mettāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || la ||
sn46.54:12.3: mettāsahagatam upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn46.54:12.4: So sace ākaṅkhati Appatikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti || paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || || Sa ce ākaṅkhati Paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti || appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn46.54:12.5: Sace ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti || paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn46.54:12.6: Sace ākaṅkhati Paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkulasaññī vihareyyanti appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn46.54:12.8: Appaṭikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tad ubhayam abhinivajjetvā upekha ko vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti || upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajano || || Subhaṃ vā kho pana vimokkham upasampajja viharati ||
sn46.54:12.9: subhaparamāham bhikkhave mettācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi || || Idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttim apaṭivijjhato || || 13.
sn46.54:13.1: Kathambhāvitā ca bhikkhave karuṇācetovimutti kiṅgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā || ||
sn46.54:13.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu karuṇasahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || la [pe] ||
sn46.54:13.3: karunāsahagatam upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn46.54:13.4: So sace ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkūle paṭikkuḷasaññī vihareyyanti || paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || la ||
sn46.54:13.5: Sace ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tad ubhayam abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti || upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno || ||
sn46.54:13.6: Sabbaso vā pana rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññanam atthagamā nānattasaññānam amanasikārā Ananto ākāso ti ākāsanañcāyatanam upasampajja viharati ||
sn46.54:13.7: ākāsānañcāyatanaparamāham bhikkhave karuṇācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi || || Idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃvimuttim apaṭivijjhato || || 14.
sn46.54:14.1: Kathaṃbhāvitā ca bhikkhave muditācetovimutti kiṅgatikā hoti kimparamā kimpariyosānā || ||
sn46.54:14.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu muditāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || la [pe] ||
sn46.54:14.3: muditāsahagatam upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāgā- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmim || ||
sn46.54:14.4: So sace ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti || paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || la [pe] ||
sn46.54:14.5: sa ce ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkūlañca patikkūlañca tad ubhayam abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti || upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno || ||
sn46.54:14.6: Sabbaso vā pana ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanam upasampajja viharati ||
sn46.54:14.7: viññāṇañcāyatanaparamāham bhikkhave muditācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi || || Idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃvimuttim apaṭivijjhato || || 15.
sn46.54:15.1: Kathambhāvitā ca bhikkhave upekhācetovimutt kiṅgātikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā || ||
sn46.54:15.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu upekhāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmim || la [pe] ||
sn46.54:15.3: upekhāsahagatam upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇamiṃ || ||
sn46.54:15.4: So sace ākaṅkhati Appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti || paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati ||
sn46.54:15.5: Sace ākaṅkhati Paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti || appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn46.54:15.6: Sace ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti || paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati ||
sn46.54:15.7: Sace ākaṅkhati Paṭikūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appatikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti || appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati ||
sn46.54:15.8: Sace ākaṅkhati Appatikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tad ubhayam abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti || upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno || ||
sn46.54:15.9: Sabbaso vā pana viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Natthi kiñcīti akiñcaññāyatanam upasampajja viharati || ||
sn46.54:15.10: Ākiñcaññāyatanaparamāham bhikkhave upekhācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi || || Idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃvimuttim apaṭivijjhato ti || || 1.
